files.summary: Revised the file left by the interrupted run. The existing design is kept: pipeline, chunker-v1, embedding config, segment paging, query path, pgvector server index, Bloom filter and tests. Fixes: 1) Text of foreign-owned chunks is never stored (critic fix). A per-uid `ai_text` store holds previews and a per-uid `ai_lex` holds BM25 body postings; `ai_chunks` holds no text; server `pull` returns text only for the requester's own files; the BM25 name field is computed from the live tree at query time, so renames are free. 2) Delete now uses `ai.index.drop` after the `vfs.unlink` event plus a live-tree invariant (I-A9), matching data_flows and architecture.md; the transaction-hook seam is removed. 3) Renamed `mm.prefetch` to `mem.prefetch`/`mem.hint`. 4) Capabilities `ai.search`, `ai.search.serve` and `ai.index`; the semsearch argument is now `scope`. 5) Fixed the safe-mode contradiction: EAIUNAVAIL safe-mode, and Files search falls back to name matching. 6) Chown handling, Spec-vs-design note on the owner held by reference, reservation-based page-in of ai.embed, and illustrative/pilot labels. 7) Test titles renumbered to spec IDs.

New. The full Subsystem B pipeline: process model and states, the `ai` command and exit codes, the datamarked envelope, the SYSTEM_V1 principles, and the tool catalogue (read-only tools each exactly one syscall; mutating tools as `submit_plan` step variants, with the reason given; quarantined `extract_list`). Also: the Valibot to strict-schema post-processor, the ≤6-turn observation loop with a server-side append-only transcript, clarifying questions, intent binding (verbatim span + verb lexicon) with argument grounding, the 9-check validator on an overlay, the dry run and blast radius (agent deletions go to `~/.trash/<txn>`), the single kernel confirmation predicate, kernel-owned TTY confirmation, and the HMAC token. Then `batch` execution as one IndexedDB transaction plus one vfsTxn with the fingerprint re-check, what 'informs the system' means for B, kill mid-plan (AbortSignal plus pg_cancel_backend plus an audited `debug.delay` only on the defence profile), audit records and `ai log`, `ai undo`, root drop with per-plan elevation, and degradation. Interfaces (syscalls, gateway HTTP, provider call with verified Opus 5.5 constraints), invariants, an errno table using only C3 errnos, budgets, 50+ tests, and the AGT-40 and INJ-20 fixture formats.

New. Covers the telemetry event schema and per-uid ring (4,096 events, relaxed durability; no content; prefetch and restore launches excluded from training) and Settings → Privacy (view, clear, export to a VFS file, opt-in consent stored server-side, prefetch toggle). It gives the Witten-Bell interpolated Markov-2 model with its math, lazy 14-day decay and O(1) update, MFU cold start below 50 launches and reason strings, plus the naive-Bayes challenger rule (+2 points). The prefetch policy: θ = 0.4, idle ≥ 2 s, free memory ≥ bytes + 16 MB, PRI 39 jobs that warm code, state and files via `mem.prefetch` and read-only `open`, and the app's DAG closure. Speculative pages are evicted first, discarded after 5 min and adopted on launch. Also: residency hints, indexer ordering, stage-6 boot prefetch, `predict` and the Task Manager panel, the PRE-03 A/B latency harness, and a prequential chronological evaluation against MFU and MRU. Plus interfaces, telemetry HTTP routes, SQL shape, invariants, errors, budgets and tests per PRE ID.

New. Holds all 12 AI-native property cells (AIN-*) and all 18 coupling-map cells (CPL-*), each with a mechanism and a named test that was cross-checked to exist. Also: the litmus CI job with seams, AI-off build, path filter and 6 assertions; the trust-boundary principles mapped per subsystem; 11 prompt-injection defence layers with a technique-to-layer table; the eval datasets (RAG corpus 60/15 → 200/30 → 300/50, rag-leak, AGT-40, INJ-20, telemetry traces, recorded embeddings keyed by (modelKey, sha256), cassettes) and harness commands; the metrics and targets table; the pre-registered LLM bake-off protocol with the single selection rule quoted verbatim; model config and pricing, with Anthropic facts verified against the Claude API reference (Opus 5.5 $4/$20 with cache read $0.20; Opus 5 $5/$25; Sonnet 4.6 $3/$15 accepts temperature; Gemini challenger; Qwen expected loser; Haiku 4.5 ineligible); the temperature-0 instructor sign-off with the refusal path; cassette design and scrubbing; cost accounting, caps and the report; the descoping rule and Week-12 checkpoint; Demo Day ordering; AI.md contents; `llm_requests`/`llm_usage` shapes; and the AIS-01..12 IDs.

cross_spec_requests: 01-architecture/syscall-abi.md: add the AI syscalls ai.semsearch, ai.search.focus, ai.index.status|lookup|embed|put|drop, ai.search.serve|done, ai.agent.plan|extract|submit|confirm|log|undo, ai.telemetry.read|list|clear|export|consent, ai.predict.publish|query|latency, mem.hint, mem.prefetch, debug.delay. Add grep (fixed string; modes l/c; names or counts only) and wc as syscalls if missing. `batch` gains planId, subtreeDigests and elevation. Add capabilities ai.search (user default), ai.search.serve, ai.index, ai.plan, batch.grant, fs.scope={cwd,$HOME}, ai.telemetry, ai.predict, mm.speculative. Add event topics ai.index.progress, ai.model, ai.predict, mem.speculative, window.ready. Do NOT adopt the research strategy's ESTALE, EINTR, EAIRATE or EAIBUDGET: use EAGAIN detail.reason stale-plan|changed-since, ECANCELED, ENOTTY, ETIMEDOUT, and EAIUNAVAIL detail.reason ∈ {offline, rate, budget, nokey, upstream, timeout, expired, safe-mode}.

01-architecture/architecture.md: in the §5.5 semsearch walkthrough, pass no `scope` by default (only --dir or the Files box set it), and name the capability `ai.search` held by user processes. In §5.6 step 5, mutating tool calls arrive as the steps of ONE submit_plan call, because disable_parallel_tool_use plus the 6-turn cap rules out one tool per step. Architecture open question 6 is answered: subsystem B's 'informs the system' mechanism is kept (agentic-shell §3.15).

04-vfs/virtual-file-system.md (owner of the C4 IndexedDB store list): add stores ai_files, ai_chunks (indexes byHash, byRow), ai_vecseg, ai_text (key [uid,ino,seq]), ai_lex (key [uid,shard]) and audit (the agent audit mirror), present in every build including AI-off. The agent batch transaction scope is inodes, dentries, blobs, blob_chunks, users, undo, outbox, audit. The telemetry store key scheme is [uid,'e:'|'r:'|'l:'|'model'], durability relaxed. Add a `copy` syscall for cp -r if not defined.

09-database/database.md: file_chunks gets chunk_id identity PK (pull cursor), UNIQUE(ino,seq), a hash index on content_hash, a dentries(ino) reverse index, IMMUTABLE may_r/may_x functions mirroring vfs/perm.ts, and a seed loader for precomputed vectors. Add audit_log columns event/actor/prompt_id/txn_id/os_session_id/pid/call/target_ino/outcome/errno/detail jsonb; llm_requests and llm_usage as in ai-safety §4.3; users.telemetry_opt_in plus the telemetry_events DDL (predictive-prefetch §4.4); all with down migrations. The batch executor checks a cancel flag between op groups; debug.delay uses pg_sleep only when FAULT_INJECTION=1; a cancelled op is recorded in op_log as a deterministic ECANCELED rejection.

11-server/backend-api.md: mount POST /api/index/put, GET /api/index/pull (text only for requester-owned files), POST /api/index/search, POST /api/index/verify with the binary application/vnd.plotinium.chunks type. Mount POST /api/llm/plan, POST /api/llm/extract (tool-less), GET /api/llm/health, and PUT|POST|GET|DELETE /api/telemetry[/consent], with the shapes given in the AI specs. Add the server-side agent transcript store (in-memory dsa/lru, TTL 10 min, uid-bound), a 64 KB body limit, token buckets per uid 6/min and 60/h, per IP 30/min, at most 4 upstream calls in flight, and budget caps (per user $2/day, examiner $15/day and 100 calls, guest/demo 20 calls/day, developer $10/day, project hard cap ≤ $250). AI=0 unmounts /api/llm/*, /api/index/* and /api/telemetry*.

03-kernel/memory-and-paging.md: add clean store-backed pages (drop on evict, checksum-verified page-in from IndexedDB) for ai.search segments. ai.embed is one declared evictable page, evicted with worker.terminate(), with its reservation made before re-spawn and pinned while search is focused. Speculative pages are tagged with an app id, inserted at the LRU end, discarded after 5 min and adopted by spawn. mem.prefetch uses a non-blocking reservation (EAGAIN rather than reclaiming non-speculative pages). mem.hint makes reclaim skip the hinted app's pages once per pass. Expose adopted and wasted byte counters.

03-kernel/processes-and-scheduling.md: allow waitingOn values ai:embed, ai:search-focus, ai:query, ai:telemetry, net:llm, tty:confirm, tty:clarify and sync:result. `ps` shows PRI = priority + nice. Provide an idle detector (no input for 2 s, no interactive-band process READY or RUNNING) for the SchedulerHints seam. prefetch:* is spawned at priority 39.

02-boot/boot-and-services.md: ai.runtime.start() and ai.agent.start() do no network I/O and finish in < 50 ms. ai.embed weights load only after desktop-interactive plus idle. Safe mode skips ai.runtime, ai.indexer, ai.predictor and ai.agent. Stage 6: after desktop-interactive the session service calls ai.predict.query({k:2}) and spawns prefetch jobs, writing a bootlog line such as 'session: pre-fetch Terminal (0.62), Files (0.44)' or the reason it skipped.

07-shell/shell-and-terminal.md: register ai, semsearch and predict with man pages. The TTY line discipline must provide a kernel-only secureRead(tty, prompt) that suspends the foreground group's input, flushes type-ahead and reads one line. Every command must print file names with control characters (including ESC) escaped.

05-wm/window-manager.md: views emit window.ready after their first interactive frame, and the compositor forwards the launch input timestamp (PRE-03). The compositor-owned secure prompt must be reusable for per-plan agent elevation.

14-devops/deployment-and-ci.md: bake /models (both pinned models) and /ort into the web image with sha256 pins and exclude them from the SW precache. Set the LLM_* server env variables and keep the key only in the env_file. Run gitleaks over the repo and cassettes, plus a bundle scan for provider SDKs, hostnames and sk-ant- patterns. The litmus job builds __AI__=false plus AI=0. FAULT_INJECTION=1 is set ONLY in the local/defence compose profile: the research demo_day_readiness.md T-1 step that sets it on production is superseded by C7.

13-quality/testing-and-performance.md: add the Vitest ai-eval project (LLM_MODE=replay, no key), the litmus job with its path filter, the nightly embedding drift check (cosine ≥ 0.999), and budgets for RAG-05 warm/indexer-active/cold, PRE-01, PRE-04 frame traces, the ai-eval PR time (≤ 10 min) and the litmus time (≤ 20 min).

08-dsa/data-structures.md: dsa/bloom interface add/mayContain/rebuild (owner R4); dsa/heap bounded top-k with replaceTop; dsa/ringbuffer used for the telemetry ring; dsa/dag exposes the application-closure resolver shared by spawn and mem.prefetch.

12-security/security-model.md: record the agent trust boundary (kernel predicate, kernel-owned TTY, per-boot non-extractable HMAC key, root drop and per-plan elevation), the injection defence layers, secrets handling for the LLM key and cassettes, and the residual risk that a blind-yes user can confirm a non-destructive unrequested step.

06-sync/offline-and-sync.md: proc.signal {opId, sig} on the control lane cancels an in-flight agent batch. Add an audit.append op type for plan records that never executed. Agent batches wait for op.result (C6).

15-decisions/stack-decisions.md: replace the LLM record's estimated scores with the measured bake-off table and quote the selection rule verbatim. State the embedding/vector-store decision's real separators per the RAG amendment: the fresh-machine demo, file_chunks in §12.5, and cascade inside rm -r.

16-delivery/implementation-plan.md: plan the Week-3 bake-off (≤ $25), the Week-4 temperature-0 instructor ruling, the Week-11 RAG corpus 200/30, the Week-12 AI checkpoint with the descoping rule, the Week-13 corpus 300/50, and Week-14 AI.md plus the cost report. Use the C15 role split; research role_matrix.md predates the rebalance.

00-product/requirements-traceability.md: register the Plotinium ID prefixes AIN- (A1–A4, B1–B4, C1–C4), CPL- (A/B/C × SCHED, MEM, VFS, SHELL, DB, SEC) and AIS- (01–12) so tools/traceability.ts accepts them.
05-wm/ui-design-system.md: add components for Settings → Privacy (event table, consent toggle, clear/export) and the Task Manager Predictions panel (confidence bars, speculative bytes).
open_questions: Instructor, before the Week-4 defence: do recorded cassettes, fixed seeds, a frozen clock and 3 live runs satisfy §12.6's temperature-0 rule for Claude models that reject temperature? If refused, claude-sonnet-4-6 at temperature 0 becomes the eligible configuration.
Instructor: may the hidden AI prompts on Demo Day run on the production URL? The examiner's local stack has no API key, so the agent there shows its graceful 'unavailable' message.
Instructor: does the examiners' AGT-06 fixture count a step the model proposed but the kernel rejected as a 'tool call', or only executed syscalls? Our gates cover both (proposed ≤ 1, executed = 0).
Instructor: for the hidden AGT-07 benchmark, are clarifying questions answered interactively, and does asking count as success on ambiguous items?
Instructor: does moving agent deletions to ~/.trash/<txnId> (recoverable, still counted in quota) satisfy 'delete' for AGT-03, or is a hard delete expected?

Instructor: is refusing `ai` under a direct root login, while allowing per-plan elevation from a regular login via su plus the secure prompt, an acceptable reading of AGT-04 together with §3.4's 'never as root'?
Instructor: does the hidden RAG set contain Urdu or Roman-Urdu documents? Both embedding models are English-only.
Instructor: does §6.3 stage 6 'start pre-fetched applications' require opening windows, or is warming code, state and files (our reading of §12.4) enough?
Instructor: is hiding foreign-owned search results while offline, with a truthful notice, accepted as meeting RAG-03 and RAG-06 together?
